args.prompt:
Create an ENTIRELY NEW PHOTOREALISTIC COLOR CAMERA PHOTOGRAPH for an iPad LANDSCAPE screen. Required canvas 2732 × 2048 pixels, aspect ratio 1.333984:1 (landscape FOUR TO THREE, 4:3). A full landscape photograph, NOT a square image, not portrait, not 3:2 or 16:9, with NO crop, borders or padding. Reconstruct the approved pendant from the attached design reference as a realistically photographed physical jewel; do not edit or paste reference pixels.
Quiet dignified moment of discovering THE THREE BROTHERS PENDANT. The SINGLE WHOLE PENDANT hangs centred in the foreground, almost frontal with a tiny natural three-quarter turn, sharply visible, occupying about 60 percent of the landscape image HEIGHT and only about 28 percent of its WIDTH; generous room/background on both sides. Preserve the exact approved design and topology: THREE large flat-topped RECTANGULAR DEEP ROSE-RED BALAS RUBIES, two at upper left and upper right and one beneath the centre; ONE central large dark transparent DIAMOND, a square rotated into a diamond/lozenge shape; FOUR ROUND GREY PEARLS, one above centre, one lower left, one lower right, and one suspended below as the bottom drop. A restrained narrow angular GOLD FRAME holds this recognisable arrangement, with a small bottom link and the hanging drop. The attached image is the authoritative geometry/placement reference. Keep these THREE rubies, FOUR pearls and ONE central diamond, no new gems or redesigned jewel. The grey pearls gain real soft nacre lustre in candlelight, red stones have subdued real internal reflections, the lozenge diamond reflects candlelight naturally; no magical glow or sparkles. A very thin dark short silk suspension at top is unobtrusive; no person, hand, plinth, cushion or display case. Pendant's complete top and bottom are visible with clear margins.
Behind it is the same chosen HOME ENVIRONMENT: a plausible FIFTEENTH-CENTURY PARISIAN GOLDSMITH WORKSHOP at evening. Softly defocused dark timber and warm plaster room, a wooden jeweller's bench, a few small period hand tools lying quietly, one ordinary wax candle at the left side of the bench and another soft candle point deeper in the room. Background stays VERY SOFT so the pendant remains the sole visual focus. Warm soft candlelight from upper left skims the real gold, rubies, diamond and pearls; subtle dark brown/amber environment with restrained depth, natural optical bokeh and real physical reflections. Photographic material surfaces, not painting, illustration, CGI, plastic, fake grain or patterned AI coating. Peaceful, precious discovery, not loot or a videogame reward panel. No treasure chest, extra jewellery, extra pendant, firework, particle effect, lens flare, sparkle star, collection animation or dramatic rays.
Include exactly ONE SMALL DISCREET plain ivory typographic label near the lower right corner, with clear margin, reading exactly: Havainnekuva
Spell precisely H a v a i n n e k u v a, one word with capital H, no punctuation. Small but readable. This required word must be generated naturally in the image. NO OTHER TEXT, UI, score, buttons, headings, frame or logo. Deliver the whole new LANDSCAPE 4:3 photograph only.
